tweet.text:
I decoded SIFT, a self-improving coding agent that puts a cheap pairwise LLM judge in front of the expensive benchmark run.

The part I'd lift: give the judge the full resulting files. Against diffs alone, rank agreement with the real benchmark went from Spearman 0.40 to 0.68, at $0.011 a comparison. Swap-ordering doubled the cost and added nothing.

I scored it 5.8/10. Single runs, no error bars, and the judge's top pick wasn't the best agent its own search found on 2 of 3 benchmarks.
